title: Planet Tweaks V2.5.6 ULTRA — Purged Latency Tweaks, In-AI Flagship Engine & Ask/Execute Modes, Persistent GamerTag & Redesigned Settings
releaseNotes: Zero Input Delay Latency Purge: Thoroughly audited all 1-Click Pro Packs and eliminated queue-flooding FilterKeys repeat settings, legacy non-raw mouse curves, memory compression disables, and DX MaxFrameLatency overrides for pure buttery smooth esports frame pacing. In-AI Flagship Engine & Mode Switcher: Moved Gemini 3.8 Flash flagship model selector and introduced dedicated [Ask Mode] (advisory & specs) and [Execute Mode] (autonomous technician) directly inside the AI view. Permanent GamerTag Persistence: GamerTag is now permanently preserved in local app settings across all updates. Redesigned Cyber Settings: Beautifully overhauled settings UI with Obsidian Cyber aesthetics and streamlined navigation.
